verdict.rationale: Galileo is an AI evaluation and observability platform with configurable alerts, experiments, and prompt templates, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no documented versioning, change review, or rollback for any automation or configuration. Annotation queues (galileo-docs-40) are for human review of traces, not of automations, so they are an adjacent feature that earns no credit.
